# Petr Hýl

> Frontend Developer with an AI Workflow. Frontend developer who has been building and deploying websites, e-shops and PWAs for the web agency IMPnet as a freelancer since 2022 – around 150 projects so far. I develop with AI agents in Claude Code: I write custom skills, build multi-agent workflows and maintain a knowledge base the agents work from. A background in PR and customer support means I am comfortable working with clients in Czech, English and French.

The same CV is available in English and Czech. The Markdown and JSON Resume files hold the complete content and are the best sources for automated reading.
